recommendation: Keep this audit for the current core branch. If MedicationKnowledge is restored to core or maintained in another repository, check administrationTreatment for an example binding to http://snomed.info/sct?fhir_vs=isa/18629005 before considering the historical request fully represented in that maintained source.
issue_request: FHIR-30090 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request raised against R4 and applied for R5. It asked to add MedicationKnowledge.administrationGuideline.administrationTreatment as a 0..1 CodeableConcept for the drug administration procedure or treatment type the guideline applies to, with an example SNOMED CT descendants-of-18629005 value set.
initial_application: Commit 1683ac64141af807564d62a28932d70133142fb3 added administrationTreatment while applying the related R5 refactor from administrationGuideline to indicationGuideline/dosingGuideline. Commit bd0883f3912523b0e63ae2a99a8a3a5b353c50a2 corrected the nesting so the element became MedicationKnowledge.indicationGuideline.dosingGuideline.administrationTreatment. The stale source still has the requested 0..1 CodeableConcept element, but not the requested example binding.
additional_context: Commit 5a4307d78b0209f61bbc68d582c1e190b3aaee5c removed MedicationKnowledge from source/fhir.ini active resource/build entries. The current build URL for medicationknowledge.profile.json returns 404, and the FHIR Extension Pack checkout does not contain a maintained MedicationKnowledge resource source file. Catalog minutes from February and March 2021 record the MedicationKnowledge change batch, including FHIR-30090, as accepted and applied by Pharmacy.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-scope audit commit. No core source was changed because source/medicationknowledge/structuredefinition-MedicationKnowledge.xml is no longer authoritative current-build source.

related_jiras.note: Another MedicationKnowledge R5 catalog tracker applied in the same grouped commit and already represented on the combined branch.
Explains the administrationGuideline to indicationGuideline/dosingGuideline refactor that determines the modern path for the requested element.
